inbox/welcome-to-the-demo.body:
This is a static copy of Second Mind on sample notes. It is read-only: edits you make stay in this tab and are gone on reload; creating, moving and deleting are turned off.

Start at [[Second Mind]], open the graph, or try the Pack tab.

The real app runs locally: `python3 server.py`.

meta.title: Second Mind
meta.summary: A local, Obsidian-like notes app: markdown vault, search, 3D graph, context packs.

shrestha/builds/second-mind.body:
A local notes app. Notes are plain markdown files in a vault on disk, organised as a tree of folder notes, linked to each other, searchable and shown in a 3D graph.

The idea: **disk is unlimited and free, context is small and costly.** Everything lives on disk; each AI gets only a small, budgeted slice of it.

## Parts

- [[Vault]]: where notes live
- [[Search]]: SQLite FTS5
- [[Graph view]]: the 3D holographic graph
- [[Context packs]]: budgeted slices for an AI
- [[Local server]]: Python stdlib, `127.0.0.1` only
- [[Roadmap]]: what comes next

meta.title: Context packs
meta.summary: Pick a note, get a budgeted context slice for an AI. Zero model calls.

shrestha/builds/second-mind/context-pack.body:
A pack is built in this order, and cut at the budget:

1. Ancestor summaries, root to parent, each with its `updated` date.
2. The note: full body if it fits, else its summary.
3. Linked notes (outgoing and backlinks), summaries only: pinned first, then direct links, then newest.

The default budget is 1,500 tokens (estimate = characters / 4, labelled ≈). The pack ends with a list of what was left out. Open the Pack tab on any note to see one.

Secrets are redacted, as in [[Search]].

meta.title: Graph view
meta.summary: A 3D holographic graph on Canvas: tree edges solid, cross-links dashed.

shrestha/builds/second-mind/graph-view.body:
Drawn with Canvas 2D, no WebGL and no libraries. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, click a node to open it.

- Tree edges come from the folder structure of the [[Vault]].
- Cross-links come from `[[wiki links]]` in note bodies.
- Stale notes (summary older than 30 days) are marked.
- Press F to filter to the current branch.

meta.title: Local server
meta.summary: Python stdlib HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1:7337. Nothing leaves the laptop.

shrestha/builds/second-mind/local-server.body:
`python3 server.py`, then open http://127.0.0.1:7337.

- Binds to `127.0.0.1` only.
- Writes need an API token (generated into `.token`, mode 600) and a JSON content type.
- One write lock; a save against a stale copy gets a 409 with the current note.

It serves the [[Vault]], [[Search]] and [[Context packs]] to the app.

meta.title: Roadmap
meta.summary: Phase 1 is the app. Next: an MCP server, more MCP clients, then a Chrome extension.

shrestha/builds/second-mind/roadmap.body:
1. Vault, seed tree, FTS5 search, pack builder, local server and the app. **Done.**
2. MCP server for Claude Code, then read-only mounts of the [[Claude setup]].
3. Extra MCP clients (Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Claude desktop), each verified.
4. Chrome extension: Capture, Insert pack, Distill-in-this-chat.

Each phase is checked in use before the next.

meta.title: Search
meta.summary: SQLite FTS5 index, rebuilt from the markdown on start and updated on each write.

shrestha/builds/second-mind/search.body:
The index lives at `vault/.index.db` (stdlib `sqlite3`). Markdown stays the source of truth, so the index can always be rebuilt.

Secret-looking strings (`sk-…`, `ghp_…`, `AKIA…`, `xox…`, private keys) are redacted in search results and in [[Context packs]].

Try the search box in the sidebar, or press ⌘K to jump to any note.

meta.title: Vault
meta.summary: Plain markdown files with a small frontmatter, in their own git repo.

shrestha/builds/second-mind/vault.body:
Every note is a markdown file. Folder notes are `_index.md` inside their folder.

Frontmatter fields: `title`, `type`, `summary`, `links`, `pinned`, `updated`.

- The vault gets its own git repo; **no remote is ever added**.
- Deleting a note moves it to `.trash/`, never a hard delete.
- Saves are atomic, and a note changed on disk is never overwritten silently.

Indexed by [[Search]]; drawn by the [[Graph view]].

- Second Mind (updated 2026-11-26): A local, Obsidian-like notes app: markdown vault, search, 3D graph, context packs.
## Note: Vault
Plain markdown files with a small frontmatter, in their own git repo.
Every note is a markdown file. Folder notes are `_index.md` inside their folder.

Frontmatter fields: `title`, `type`, `summary`, `links`, `pinned`, `updated`.

- The vault gets its own git repo; **no remote is ever added**.
- Deleting a note moves it to `.trash/`, never a hard delete.
- Saves are atomic, and a note changed on disk is never overwritten silently.
